newsitem.title: SIERRA LEONE: Grenade kills 10 children in Sierra Leone.
newsitem.headline: Grenade kills 10 children in Sierra Leone.

text.p: Ten children playing with a rocket-propelled grenade in Sierra Leone were killed when the device exploded, state radio reported.
The blast, on Thursday in Njaluahun village in the eastern Kenema district, seriously wounded a further 13 children, the radio said late on Friday.
The children were aged between two and 15.
Sierra Leone's government and rebels who took up arms in 1991 agreed a peace deal in Ivory Coast in December but are still finalising implementation details. A ceasefire is in force.
